local p = {}
local uData    = mw.loadData('Module:UnitData/Data')
local uData_N  = mw.loadData('Module:UnitData/Data/Names')
local uData_AT = mw.loadData('Module:UnitData/Data/AoE_Type')

-- mw.logObject(p.get({args = {name = "Toshin (Dragon Lotus)", "total_cost"} }))

function toNil(thing)
	if thing==nil or thing=='' then return nil else return thing end
end




function p.EvolutionTable(f)
	local name = toNil(f.args["name"]) or mw.title.getCurrentTitle().text
	if not toNil(name) then return '<span style="color:red; font-weight:bold;">error</span>' end
	
	local dataname = uData_N[name]["name"]
	local unit = uData[dataname]
	
	-- if toNil(unit["evolved"]) then 
function evo(iName)
	if iName then unit = uData[iName] end
	if toNil(unit["evolve"]) then 
		evolve = unit["evolve"]["normal"]
		sizeitem = 0
		sizeUnit = 0
		evolveItem = ""
		evolveAmountItem = ""
		evolveUnit = ""
		evolveAmountUnit = ""
		TempStorage = '{{EvolutionTable/container'
		tempItem = '|Items='
		tempUnit = '|Units='
		tempText = '|Text='
		tempTextResult = '|Result='
		
		for _ in pairs(evolve["item_requirement"]) do sizeitem = sizeitem + 1
			evolveItem = evolve["item_requirement"][sizeitem]["item_id"]
			evolveAmountItem = evolve["item_requirement"][sizeitem]["amount"]
			tempItem = tempItem ..'{{Item|'.. evolveItem ..'|'.. evolveAmountItem ..'}}'
		end
		for _ in pairs(evolve["unit_requirement"]) do sizeUnit = sizeUnit + 1
			evolveUnit = evolve["unit_requirement"][sizeUnit]["unit_id"]
			Wikiname = uData[evolveUnit]["name"]
			evolveAmountUnit = evolve["unit_requirement"][sizeUnit]["amount"]
			tempUnit = tempUnit ..'{{Item/unit|'.. Wikiname ..'|'.. evolveAmountUnit ..'}}'
		end
		evolve_unit = unit["evolve"]["evolve_unit"]
		evolve_text = unit["evolve"]["evolve_text"]
		unitName = unit["name"]
		if toNil(uData[evolve_unit]) then evolveUnitName = uData[evolve_unit]["name"]
			else evolveUnitName = evolve_unit
		end
		if iName then
			tempText = tempText .. ("[[%s]] can be evolved from [[%s]] with the following materials:"):format(evolveUnitName, unitName)
		else
			tempText = tempText .. ("[[%s]] can evolve into [[%s]] with the following materials:"):format(unitName, evolveUnitName)
		end
		
		tempTextResult = tempTextResult .."{{Characterbox|".. evolveUnitName .."|check_img=true}}"

		TempStorage = TempStorage .. tempItem .. tempUnit .. tempText .. tempTextResult ..'}}'
		

	end
end

if toNil(unit["evolve"]) then evo() end
if toNil(unit["evolved"]) then 
	evolved = unit["evolved"]["from"]
	evo(evolved)
end
	
	return f:preprocess(TempStorage)
end






function p.ChBox_Text(f)
	local name = toNil(f.args["name"]) or mw.title.getCurrentTitle().text
	if not toNil(name) then return '<span style="color:red; font-weight:bold;">error</span>' end
	local text = toNil(uData_N[name]["ChBox_Text"]) or name
	return text or name or 'name'
end

function p.ChBox_Text_Style(f)
	local name = toNil(f.args["name"]) or mw.title.getCurrentTitle().text
	if not toNil(name) then return '<span style="color:red; font-weight:bold;">error</span>' end
	local text = toNil(uData_N[name]["ChBox_Text_Style"]) or nil
	return text or ""
end



function p.name(f)
	local name = toNil(f.args["name"]) or mw.title.getCurrentTitle().text
	if not toNil(name) then return '<span style="color:red; font-weight:bold;">error</span>' end
	-- local arg2 = f.args[2]	
	local unit = toNil(uData[name]) or toNil(uData[uData_N[name]["name"]])
	local dataname = unit.id
	local TempStorage = ""
	local TempStorage2 = {}
	local Effect = nil
	-- local TempStorage2 = ""
	
	size1 = 0
	for _ in pairs(unit["upgrade"]) do size1 = size1 + 1 end
	
	function mysplit1 (inputstr, sep, id)
		local t={}
		if toNil(inputstr) then
			for str in string.gmatch(inputstr, "([^"..sep.."]+)") do
				table.insert(t, str)
			end
		else return nil
		end
		return t[id]
	end
	function mysplit2 (inputstr, sep)
		local t={}
		for str in string.gmatch(inputstr, "([^"..sep.."]+)") do
			table.insert(t, str)
		end
		return t
	end
	
	if toNil(f.args["castomStats"]) then Mstr = tostring(string.gsub(f.args["castomStats"], ",", "|"))
		function printBox (inputstr, sep, id)
			TempStorage2 = {}
		
			size2 = 0
			for _ in pairs(mysplit2(Mstr, ";")) do size2 = size2 + 1
			
			temp = mysplit1(Mstr, ";",size2)
			TE = tonumber(mysplit1(temp, "|", 1))
			if not toNil(TE) then return nil end
			table.insert(TempStorage2, TE, temp)
			end
		end
		printBox()
	end
	
	
	
	-- Tower_Type
	TT = "Ground"
	if toNil(unit.hill_unit) then TT = "HILL"
	elseif toNil(unit.hybrid_placement) then TT = "Hybrid" end
		
	if toNil(unit.spawn_unit) then TT = TT .. " SUMN" end
	if toNil(unit.aura_buff) then TT = TT .. " BUFF" end
	
	-- Attack_Type
	AT = {}
	if toNil(unit.primary_attack_no_upgrades) then
		tempPrA = unit.primary_attack_no_upgrades
		if toNil(uData_AT[tempPrA]) then AT = uData_AT[tempPrA] end
	else AT.AOE_TYPE = tempPrA
	end
	--mw.logObject(AT)
	-- EffectName

	cost   = toNil(unit["cost"]) or ''
	dmg    = toNil(unit["damage"]) or ''
	range  = toNil(unit["range"]) or ''
	spa    = toNil(unit["attack_cooldown"]) or ''
	crit_chance   = toNil(unit["crit_chance"]) or ''
	AAtt   = toNil(unit["active_attack"]) or ''
	AAttSt = toNil(unit["active_attack_stats"]) or ''
	farm   = toNil(unit["farm_amount"]) or ''
	note   = toNil(unit["note"]) or ''
	note2  = toNil(unit["note2"]) or ''
	
	if toNil(unit["spawn_unit"]) then
		if unit["spawn_unit"] == true then runnersHealth = toNil(unit["health"]) or '' end
	end
	
	temp = ''
	if (cost  ~= '') and (cost   ~= 0) then temp = temp ..'|Upgrade_Cost='..  cost end
	if (dmg   ~= '') and (dmg    ~= 0) then temp = temp ..'|Damage='..         dmg end
	if (range ~= '') and (range  ~= 0) then temp = temp ..'|Range='..        range end
	if (spa   ~= '') and (spa    ~= 0) then temp = temp ..'|SPA='..            spa end
	if (crit_chance   ~= '') and (crit_chance    ~= 0) then temp = temp ..'|Crit_chance='.. crit_chance * 100 end
	if (TT    ~= '') and (TT     ~= 0) then temp = temp ..'|Tower_Type='..      TT end
	if (note  ~= nil) and (note  ~= 0) then temp = temp ..'|Text_Line_1='..   note end
	if (note2 ~= nil) and (note2 ~= 0) then temp = temp ..'|Text_Line_2='..  note2 end
	
	-- if (TT    ~= '') and (TT     ~= 0) then  temp = temp ..'Effect_Name'..
	-- if (TT    ~= '') and (TT     ~= 0) then  temp = temp ..'Effect_Ticks'..
	-- if (TT    ~= '') and (TT     ~= 0) then  temp = temp ..'Effect_Ticks DMG Multiplier'..
	if toNil(AT["AOE_TYPE"]) then
		ATstring = AT["AOE_TYPE"]

		for k, v in pairs(AT) do
			if k ~= "Effect" and  k ~= "AOE_TYPE" and  k ~= "Special_Effect" and  k ~= "Hits" then
				ATstring = ATstring .. ' <span style="font-variant-caps: all-small-caps;">- '.. k ..':</span> '.. v
			end
		end
		temp = temp ..'|Attack_Type='.. ATstring
	end
	if toNil(AT["Hits"]) then Hits = AT["Hits"] end
	if toNil(Hits) then
		temp = temp ..'|Hits=<span class="advanced-tooltip Stats-Box-dotted_Effect"><span class="C(wiki-theme-page)" style="pointer-events: none;">Hits: '.. Hits ..'</span><div class="tooltip-contents mobile-hidden" style="display: none;"><div class="game-tooltip__container game-font-face">Attacks '.. Hits ..' times in a single attack. Damage stated by the unit itself will be divided by the number of hits. This can take out that number of shields from enemy units, and can potentially 1-shot 2-barred enemies.</div></div></span>'
	end
	if toNil(AT["Special_Effect"]) then SpecialEffect = AT["Special_Effect"] end
	if toNil(SpecialEffect) then
		SE_Name = SpecialEffect["Name"]
		if toNil(uData_AT["Special_Effect_List"][SE_Name]) then 
			
			specialEffect = ""
			if toNil(AT["Special_Effect"]["Influence"]) then
				specialEffect = specialEffect .." ".. AT["Special_Effect"]["Influence"] * 100 .. "%" end
			if toNil(AT["Special_Effect"]["Duration"]) then
			specialEffect = specialEffect .." ".. AT["Special_Effect"]["Duration"] .. "s" end
		
			note = toNil(uData_AT["Special_Effect_List"][SE_Name]["note"])
			link = toNil(uData_AT["Special_Effect_List"][SE_Name]["link"])
			temp = temp ..'|Special_Effect=<span class="advanced-tooltip Stats-Box-dotted_Effect">[['.. link ..'|<span class="C(wiki-theme-page)" style="pointer-events: none;">'.. SE_Name .. specialEffect ..'</span>]]<div class="tooltip-contents mobile-hidden" style="display: none;"><div class="game-tooltip__container game-font-face">Effect '.. note ..'</div></div></span>'
		end
	end
	if toNil(AT["Effect"]) then Effect = AT.Effect end
	if toNil(Effect) then
		temp = temp ..'|Effect_Name='.. Effect.Name
		temp = temp ..'|Effect_Ticks='.. Effect.Ticks
		temp = temp ..'|Effect_Ticks DMG Multiplier='.. Effect.Multiplier
	end
	if (AAtt  ~= '') and (AAtt   ~= 0) then temp = temp ..'|active_attack='.. AAtt end
	if (farm  ~= '') and (farm   ~= 0) then temp = temp ..'|farm_amount='..   farm end
	if (runnersHealth  ~= '') and (runnersHealth   ~= 0) and (runnersHealth   ~= nil) then temp = temp ..'|Spawn='.. runnersHealth end
	if AAttSt ~= nil then 
		if toNil(AAttSt["damage"]) and (toNil(AAttSt["damage"]) ~= 0) then
			temp = temp ..'|active_attack_damage='.. toNil(AAttSt["damage"])
		end
		if toNil(AAttSt["attack_cooldown"]) and (toNil(AAttSt["attack_cooldown"]) ~= 0) then
			temp = temp ..'|active_attack_attack_cooldown='.. toNil(AAttSt["attack_cooldown"])
		end
		if toNil(AAttSt["attack_duration"]) and (toNil(AAttSt["attack_duration"]) ~= 0) then
			temp = temp ..'|active_attack_attack_duration='.. toNil(AAttSt["attack_duration"])
		end
	end
	
	
	TempStorage =  '{{Stats Box'.. temp ..'|Upgrade_No='.. (toNil(TempStorage2[0]) or 0) ..'}}'

	for i = 1, size1 do

	-- Attack_Type
		AT = {}
		if toNil(unit.upgrade[i].primary_attack) then
			tempPrA = unit.upgrade[i].primary_attack
			if toNil(uData_AT[tempPrA]) then
				AT = uData_AT[tempPrA]
			else AT["AOE_TYPE"] = tempPrA
			end
		end
	-- mw.logObject(AT)
		if toNil(unit["end_of_wave"]) then end_of_wave = toNil(unit["end_of_wave"][1]["type"]) end
		cost   = toNil(unit["upgrade"][i]["cost"])
		dmg    = toNil(unit["upgrade"][i]["damage"])
		range  = toNil(unit["upgrade"][i]["range"])
		spa    = toNil(unit["upgrade"][i]["attack_cooldown"])
		note   = toNil(unit["upgrade"][i]["note"])
		note2  = toNil(unit["upgrade"][i]["note2"])
		AAtt   = toNil(unit["upgrade"][i]["active_attack"])
		AAttSt = toNil(unit["upgrade"][i]["active_attack_stats"])
		farm   = toNil(unit["upgrade"][i]["farm_amount"])
 runnersHealth = toNil(unit["upgrade"][i]["health"])



		temp = ''

		if (cost  ~= nil) and (cost  ~= 0) then temp = temp ..'|Upgrade_Cost='..  cost end
		if (dmg   ~= nil) and (dmg   ~= 0) then temp = temp ..'|Damage='..         dmg end
		if (range ~= nil) and (range ~= 0) then temp = temp ..'|Range='..        range end
		if (spa   ~= nil) and (spa   ~= 0) then temp = temp ..'|SPA='..            spa end
		if (note  ~= nil) and (note  ~= 0) then temp = temp ..'|Text_Line_1='..   note end
		if (note2 ~= nil) and (note2 ~= 0) then temp = temp ..'|Text_Line_2='..  note2 end
		
		if toNil(AT["AOE_TYPE"]) then
			ATstring = 'Attack type changes to '.. AT.AOE_TYPE
			for k, v in pairs(AT) do
				if k ~= "Effect" and  k ~= "AOE_TYPE" and  k ~= "Special_Effect" and  k ~= "Hits" then
					ATstring = ATstring .. ' <span style="font-variant-caps: all-small-caps;">- '.. k ..':</span> '.. v
				end
			end
			temp = temp ..'|Text_Line_3='.. ATstring
		end
		if toNil(AT["Hits"]) then Hits = AT["Hits"] end
		if toNil(Hits) then
			temp = temp ..'|Hits=<span class="advanced-tooltip Stats-Box-dotted_Effect"><span class="C(wiki-theme-page)" style="pointer-events: none;">Hits: '.. Hits ..'</span><div class="tooltip-contents mobile-hidden" style="display: none;"><div class="game-tooltip__container game-font-face">Attacks '.. Hits ..' times in a single attack. Damage stated by the unit itself will be divided by the number of hits. This can take out that number of shields from enemy units, and can potentially 1-shot 2-barred enemies.</div></div></span>'
		end
		if toNil(AT["Special_Effect"]) then SpecialEffect = AT["Special_Effect"] end
		if toNil(SpecialEffect) then
			SE_Name = SpecialEffect["Name"]
			if toNil(uData_AT["Special_Effect_List"][SE_Name]) then 
				
				specialEffect = ""
					-- mw.logObject(AT)
				 if toNil(SpecialEffect["Influence"]) then
				 	specialEffect = specialEffect .." ".. SpecialEffect["Influence"] * 100 .. "%" end
				 if toNil(SpecialEffect["Duration"]) then
				 specialEffect = specialEffect .." ".. SpecialEffect["Duration"] .. "s" end

					
				note = toNil(uData_AT["Special_Effect_List"][SE_Name]["note"])
				link = toNil(uData_AT["Special_Effect_List"][SE_Name]["link"])
				temp = temp ..'|Special_Effect=<span class="advanced-tooltip Stats-Box-dotted_Effect">[['.. link  ..'|<span class="C(wiki-theme-page)" style="pointer-events: none;">'.. SE_Name .. specialEffect ..'</span>]]<div class="tooltip-contents mobile-hidden" style="display: none;"><div class="game-tooltip__container game-font-face">Effect '.. note ..'</div></div></span>'
			end
		end
		if toNil(AT["Effect"]) then Effect = AT.Effect end
		if toNil(Effect) then
					temp = temp ..'|Effect_Name='.. Effect.Name
					temp = temp ..'|Effect_Ticks='.. Effect.Ticks
					temp = temp ..'|Effect_Ticks DMG Multiplier='.. Effect.Multiplier
		end
		-- if (AT.AOE_TYPE    ~= nil) and (AT.AOE_TYPE    ~= 0) then temp = temp ..'|Text_Line_3=Attack type change to '.. AT.AOE_TYPE end
		-- if (AT.P    ~= nil) and (AT.AOE_TYPE    ~= 0) then temp = temp ..'|Text_Line_3=Attack type "change" to '.. AT.AOE_TYPE end
		if (AAtt  ~= nil) and (AAtt  ~= 0) then temp = temp ..'|active_attack='.. AAtt end
		if (farm  ~= nil) and (farm  ~= 0) then temp = temp ..'|farm_amount='..   farm end
		if (runnersHealth ~= nil) and (farm  ~= 0) then temp = temp ..'|Spawn='.. runnersHealth end

		if AAttSt ~= nil then 
			if toNil(AAttSt["damage"]) and (toNil(AAttSt["damage"]) ~= 0) then
				temp = temp ..'|active_attack_damage='.. toNil(AAttSt["damage"])
			end
			if toNil(AAttSt["attack_cooldown"]) then
				temp = temp ..'|active_attack_attack_cooldown='.. toNil(AAttSt["attack_cooldown"])
			end
			if toNil(AAttSt["attack_duration"]) then
				temp = temp ..'|active_attack_attack_duration='.. toNil(AAttSt["attack_duration"])
			end
		end


		TempStorage = TempStorage .. '{{Stats Box'.. temp ..'|Upgrade_No='.. (toNil(TempStorage2[i]) or i) ..'}}'

	end


return f:preprocess(TempStorage)








end








function p.Get_NonEvoName()

	local name = mw.title.getCurrentTitle().text
	if not toNil(name) then return 'Unknown' end
	
	local dataname = uData_N[name]["name"]
	local unit = uData[dataname]
	
	
	if toNil(unit["evolve"]) then return name end
	if toNil(unit["evolved"]) then 
		from = unit["evolved"]["from"]
		unitFrom = uData[from]["name"]
		return unitFrom
	end

end






function p.get(f)
	
	local name = toNil(f.args["name"]) or mw.title.getCurrentTitle().text
	if not toNil(name) then return '<span style="color:red; font-weight:bold;">error</span>' end
	local get = toNil(f.args[1])
	local unit = toNil(uData[name]) or toNil(uData[uData_N[name]["name"]])
	local dataname = unit.id
	local TempStorage = ""
	local MaxCost = 0
	size1 = 0
	if not toNil(unit["upgrade"]) then return "" end
	for _ in pairs(unit["upgrade"]) do size1 = size1 + 1 end
	
	
	if get == "Non_Evo_Name" then
		if not toNil(name) then return 'Unknown' end
		
		if toNil(unit["evolve"]) then return name end
		if toNil(unit["evolved"]) then 
			from = unit["evolved"]["from"]
			unitFrom = uData[from]["name"]
			return unitFrom
		end
	end
	
	
	if get == "base_damage_type:text" then
		if toNil(unit._base_damage_type) then temp = unit._base_damage_type
			return temp end
	end
	if get == "base_damage_type" then
		if toNil(unit._base_damage_type) then temp = '{{Tower Infobox/Damage type|'.. unit._base_damage_type ..'}}'
			return f:preprocess(temp) end
	end
	if get == "secondary_damage_types" then 
		temp = ""
		if toNil(unit._secondary_damage_types) then
			for k, v in pairs(unit._secondary_damage_types) do
				if v == true then temp = '{{Tower Infobox/Damage type|'.. k ..'}}' end
			end
		end
		if toNil(unit._show_secondary_damage_types) then 
			for k, v in pairs(unit._show_secondary_damage_types) do
				if v == true and temp ~= "" then temp = temp ..'<br>{{Tower Infobox/Damage type|'.. k ..'}}'
				elseif v == true and temp == "" then temp = '{{Tower Infobox/Damage type|'.. k ..'}}' end
			end
		end
		
		if temp ~= '' then return f:preprocess(temp) end
	end

	
	if get == "total_cost" then
		for i = 1, size1 do
			MaxCost = MaxCost + toNil(unit["upgrade"][i]["cost"]) end
		return MaxCost + toNil(unit["cost"])
	end

	

	if (get == "attack_type") and toNil(unit.primary_attack_no_upgrades) then
		TempStorage = ''
		AT = {}
		AT2 = {}
		tempPrA2 = unit.primary_attack_no_upgrades
		if toNil(uData_AT[tempPrA2]) then
			if toNil(uData_AT[tempPrA2]["AOE_TYPE"]) then
				TempStorage = TempStorage .. uData_AT[tempPrA2]["AOE_TYPE"]
				for k, v in pairs(uData_AT[tempPrA2]) do
					if k ~= "Effect" and  k ~= "AOE_TYPE" and  k ~= "Special_Effect" then
						TempStorage = TempStorage ..' <span style="font-variant-caps: all-small-caps;">- '.. k ..':</span> '.. v
					end
				end
			end
		else TempStorage = tempPrA2
		end
		
		for i = 1, size1 do
			if toNil(unit.upgrade[i].primary_attack) then 
				tempPrA = unit.upgrade[i].primary_attack
				if toNil(uData_AT[tempPrA]) then
					if toNil(uData_AT[tempPrA]["AOE_TYPE"]) then
						TempStorage = TempStorage.." -><br>".. uData_AT[tempPrA]["AOE_TYPE"]
						for kk, vv in pairs(uData_AT[tempPrA]) do
							if kk ~= "Effect" and  kk ~= "AOE_TYPE" and  kk ~= "Special_Effect" then
								TempStorage = TempStorage.. ' <span style="font-variant-caps: all-small-caps;">- '.. kk ..':</span> '.. vv
							end
						end
					end
				else TempStorage = TempStorage.." -><br>".. tempPrA
				end
			end
		end
		return TempStorage
	end
	
	if get == "tower_type" then
		TT = "Ground"
		if toNil(unit.hill_unit) then TT = "HILL"
		elseif toNil(unit.hybrid_placement) then TT = "Hybrid" end
			
			
		if toNil(unit.farm_amount) then TT = TT .. " FARM" end
		if toNil(unit.spawn_unit) then TT = TT .. " SUMN" end
		if toNil(unit.aura_buff) then TT = TT .. " BUFF" end
		
		return TT
	end
	
	if get == "crit_chance" then
		if toNil(unit.crit_chance) then CC = (unit.crit_chance * 100) .. '%'
		else return end
		return CC
	end
	
	if get == "upgrade_levels" then return size1 end
	
	if get == "upgrade" then
		local arg3 = toNil(f.args[2])
		local arg4 = toNil(f.args[3]) or 1
		if arg4 == "max" then
			return toNil(unit["upgrade"][size1][arg3])
		end
		return toNil(unit["upgrade"][tonumber(arg4)][arg3])
	end
	return unit[get]
end

function evolve_info()
	local idata = mw.loadData('Module:ItemData/Data')
	
	local name = f.args['item']
	local unitname = f.args['unit']
	local dataunitname = uData_N[name]["name"]
	local unit = uData[dataunitname]
	unitEvolve_text = unit["evolve"]["evolve_text"]
	
	if not toNil(name) then return 'name' end
	tempName = iuData_N[name]
	item = iuData[tempName]
	itemdescription= item.description
	itemflavor = item.flavor
	itemRarity = item.rarity
	 mw.html.create('div')
	 :css( 'width', '100%' )
		:wikitext(' ')
			:tag('span'):attr('class','dottedText')
			:wikitext('Used on'.. unitname ..'<br>')
			:wikitext(itemRarity..'<br>')
			:wikitext(itemflavor):done()

end

return p
